context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren discuss a difficult decision.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business chat; vocabulary (向かう/話し合い/させる/おっしゃる/ライト) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 解決に向かうため、話し合いを開こう。
lines.en: To head toward a resolution, let's hold a discussion.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 皆を、納得させたいですね。
lines.en: I want to get everyone on board.
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 担当者は、何とおっしゃっていた?
lines.en: What did the person in charge say?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 前向きに進めたいと、おっしゃっていました。
lines.en: They said they want to proceed positively.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会議室のライトを、つけておいてくれ。
lines.en: Turn on the meeting room lights.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ライトをつけて、準備させます。
lines.en: I'll turn on the lights and have it prepared.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 話し合いで、未来へ向かおう。
lines.en: Through discussion, let's head to the future.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 良い方向に向かうよう、努めます。
lines.en: I'll strive to head in a good direction.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
